name: akan-benchmarks
description: Performance benchmark harness for akanjs: cross-framework comparison + internal tracing.

scripts.build:competitors: bun build competitors/raw-bun/server.ts --target bun --outfile dist/competitors/raw-bun/server.js && bun build competitors/elysia/server.ts --target bun --outfile dist/competitors/elysia/server.js && bun build competitors/hono/server.ts --target bun --outfile dist/competitors/hono/server.js && bun build competitors/raw-sqlite/server.ts --target bun --outfile dist/competitors/raw-sqlite/server.js && bun build competitors/fastify/server.ts --target node --outfile dist/competitors/fastify/server.js
scripts.build:all-production: (cd ../.. && AKAN_PUBLIC_APP_NAME=minimal AKAN_PUBLIC_REPO_NAME=Ieading-flight-guidance AKAN_PUBLIC_SERVE_DOMAIN=akanjs.com AKAN_PUBLIC_ENV=local AKAN_PUBLIC_OPERATION_MODE=local PORT_OFFSET=100 BENCH_AKAN_PORT=8383 bun run akan build minimal) && bun run build:competitors
